notesEn.UKR: Tests in Crimea count for Ukraine, following the UN (as in the population grid; the map’s borders draw Crimea inside Russia).
notesEn.TWN: Taiwan’s outlying islands (Penghu, Matsu, Orchid Island, Green Island, Pratas, Wuqiu) have no shapes in the 1:50m borders and are added by their extent; Kinmen is within the border. Official fixed-site mobile measurements use a different method: NCC’s 2021 4G national mean was 122.53 Mbps down and 24.92 Mbps up; the Ministry of Digital Affairs’ 2023 5G results averaged 95–589 Mbps down across 22 counties, depending on the operator. Staff measure each operator at fixed sites with test phones, while Ookla tests come from users’ own phones mixing 4G and 5G, so they are not directly comparable; see the side panel.
